sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看英国广播公司英文课的6分钟英语课

sentences.en: I’m Phil and today we have Hannah joining us again from BBC podcast, What in the World.
sentences.zh: 我是Phil, 今天我们又让Hannah从BBC播客“什么世界”中加入我们。

sentences.en: Welcome Hannah. Hey Phil, it is so great to be back here.
sentences.zh: 欢迎汉娜 菲尔 回来真好

sentences.en: So, I’m wondering, do you do things that you think are good for the planet?
sentences.zh: 所以,我在想,你是否做了你认为对地球有好处的事情?

sentences.en: I try, but I don't think I do enough. So, maybe I cycle more than I drive, and I try to recycle things, but I should be doing a lot more.
sentences.zh: 我尝试了,但我认为我做得还不够。所以,也许我循环的比开车的还多, 我试着回收东西, 但我应该做更多。

sentences.en: But some people think that to deal with climate change, we can’t just rely on individuals.
sentences.zh: 但有些人认为,要应对气候变化,我们不能仅仅依靠个人。

sentences.en: Phil, it’s not up to you and me. We need to actually change the way our economy works.
sentences.zh: 菲尔,这不取决于你我,我们需要改变我们的经济运作方式。

sentences.en: And this is an idea called degrowth, and we’ve been investigating it at What in the World, and we’re going to learn more about it today.
sentences.zh: 这个想法叫做“脱增长”, 我们一直在研究世界的什么, 我们今天将会学到更多关于它的知识。

sentences.en: But first, our quiz question. World leaders promised in 2015 to limit global temperature rises.
sentences.zh: 但首先,我们的问题。 世界各国领导人承诺在2015年限制全球气温上升。

sentences.en: But what was the limit they agreed to? Was it: a.
sentences.zh: 但是,他们同意的限度是多少?

sentences.en: 1.5C? b. 2.5C? c. 3.5C? I think I know this one, Phil.
sentences.zh: 我想我知道这个,菲尔。

sentences.en: I think it's 1.5C. OK. We'll find out the answer later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 我想是1.5C 好吧 我们稍后在节目里会找出答案

sentences.en: So, Hannah, you’ve been researching degrowth – what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 所以,汉娜,你一直在研究脱毛问题,这是什么意思?

sentences.en: Well Phil, traditionally governments have always wanted to grow the economy.
sentences.zh: 菲尔 传统上政府一直想发展经济

sentences.en: More money, more jobs and more stuff. But degrowth is a different way of thinking about things.
sentences.zh: 更多的钱,更多的工作,更多的东西。但是脱增长是不同的思考方式。

sentences.en: Some people say that to tackle the climate crisis we need to stop our economies from growing.
sentences.zh: 有些人说,为了应对气候危机,我们需要阻止我们的经济增长。

sentences.en: We need to stop using and making more and focus on using fewer of the Earth’s natural resources.
sentences.zh: 我们需要停止使用和创造更多的资源,并把重点放在减少地球自然资源的使用上。

sentences.en: The people who support the idea of degrowth, are often called degrowthers.
sentences.zh: 支持脱增长理念的人,常常被称为脱增长者。

sentences.en: Right, OK, so degrowthers argue we should make and use less stuff.
sentences.zh: 好了,好吧,所以脱脂者 认为我们应该做 和使用较少的东西。

sentences.en: Yes, mostly. It's a little bit more complex than that.
sentences.zh: 是的,大部分是,比这复杂一点

sentences.en: And I spoke to BBC journalist Alvaro Alvarez, who told me more about the idea.
sentences.zh: 我和BBC记者Alvaro Alvarez谈过了, 他告诉我更多关于这个想法。

sentences.en: So, degrowth is not saying that we need to reduce everything.
sentences.zh: 所以,脱增长并不是说我们需要减少一切。

sentences.en: It’s saying that we need to decrease some elements of our production that are not beneficial.
sentences.zh: 指出我们需要减少我们生产中一些无益的成分。

sentences.en: An example of those elements would be fast fashion, private jets, the beef and meat industry.
sentences.zh: 这些要素的一个例子是快速时装、私人喷气式飞机、牛肉和肉类工业。

sentences.en: So it’s not about decreasing everything.
sentences.zh: 所以这与减少一切无关。

sentences.en: Alvaro says that degrowthers believe we should reduce some elements of production.
sentences.zh: 阿尔瓦罗说,脱脂者认为,我们应该减少某些生产要素。

sentences.en: An element of something is a part of something.
sentences.zh: 某事的一个元素 是某事的一部分。

sentences.en: And according to Alvaro, these elements of production are not believed to be beneficial.
sentences.zh: 据Alvaro说,这些生产要素被认为没有好处。

sentences.en: If something is beneficial it is useful or good.
sentences.zh: 如果有什么好处 是有用的或好的。

sentences.en: One example of a kind of production that degrowthers disagree with is fast fashion.
sentences.zh: 脱脂者不同意的一种生产的例子就是快速的时尚。

sentences.en: Fast fashion refers to clothes that are made very cheaply and quickly, so that customers can afford to buy new outfits more often.
sentences.zh: 快速时尚是指非常便宜和快速制造的衣服,使顾客能够更经常地买到新的服装。

sentences.en: Exactly. And before we go any further, many economists do not think that degrowth is a good idea.
sentences.zh: 没错。在我们走得更远之前,许多经济学家并不认为减速是一个好主意。

sentences.en: Some of them argue that it would create more poverty.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人认为,这会造成更多的贫困。

sentences.en: And some economists believe degrowth would actually make it harder to solve the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 一些经济学家认为 减速会让气候危机 更难以解决

sentences.en: For example, Professor Sam Fankhauser, an economist at Cambridge University in the UK, spoke to you on What in the World.
sentences.zh: 例如,英国剑桥大学经济学家Sam Fankhauser教授就“世界”问题向你们讲了话。

sentences.en: And he argues that degrowth could limit innovation.
sentences.zh: 他争辩说,减速会限制创新。

sentences.en: I think degrowth underestimates the power of innovation.
sentences.zh: 我认为减速低估了创新的力量。

sentences.en: Degrowth underestimates the need for investment that we need in new technology and in new solutions.
sentences.zh: 增长下降低估了我们需要投资于新技术和新解决办法的必要性。

sentences.en: And degrowth underestimates the social, sort of, feasibility of what they propose.
sentences.zh: 减肥低估了他们提议的社会, 某种程度上的可行性。

sentences.en: So, Professor Fankhauser thinks that degrowth underestimates many things, such as innovation.
sentences.zh: 因此,范考瑟教授认为,减速低估了许多东西,比如创新。

sentences.en: If you underestimate something, you don’t understand the true importance or size of it.
sentences.zh: 如果你低估了某些东西, 你不了解它的真正重要性或大小。

sentences.en: Another factor that Professor Fankhauser says is underestimated by degrowthers is the feasibility of social change.
sentences.zh: Fankhauser教授说,减少增长者低估的另一个因素是社会变革的可行性。

sentences.en: Feasibility means the possibility that something can be achieved.
sentences.zh: 可行性意味着有可能实现某种目标。

sentences.en: It comes from the adjective feasible. For example, I could say that I think it’s feasible for us to finish this podcast in six minutes.
sentences.zh: 这来自形容词的可行性。 比如,我可以说,我认为六分钟后完成这个播客是可行的。

sentences.en: I think that we can do it! Well, Phil, we're going to have to get a move on.
sentences.zh: 我想我们能做到的 菲尔 我们得快点了

sentences.en: I think it's time to hear the answer to your quiz question.
sentences.zh: 我想是时候听听你的测验问题了

sentences.en: I asked how much world leaders agreed to limit global temperature rises to.
sentences.zh: 我问世界领导人同意将全球气温升高限制到多少。

sentences.en: The answer is 1.5C, which scientists believe is needed to stop the worst impacts of climate change.
sentences.zh: 答案是1.5C, 科学家们认为,为了制止气候变化最严重的影响, 需要这样做。

sentences.en: I got it right! OK, so let’s recap some of the vocabulary we’ve learned, starting with degrowth, which is the economic idea that we should use and make less stuff.
sentences.zh: 我想对了! 好吧,让我们回顾一下我们学到的一些词汇,从减肥开始,这是我们应该使用和少做一些东西的经济想法。

sentences.en: An element of something means a part of something.
sentences.zh: 某种元素意味着某种元素的一部分

sentences.en: Beneficial means useful or good. Fast fashion refers to clothes that are made cheaply and quickly, so that people can buy them more often.
sentences.zh: 好处意味着有用或好。 快速时装是指廉价和快速制成的衣服,这样人们可以更经常地买到这些衣服。

sentences.en: And, if you underestimate something, you don’t understand the true importance or size of it.
sentences.zh: 如果你低估了某些东西, 你不了解它的真正重要性或大小。

sentences.en: The feasibility of something is the likelihood that it can be achieved.
sentences.zh: 某种可能性是有可能实现。

sentences.en: We can also describe something as feasible or unfeasible.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以描述一些不可行或不可行的东西。

sentences.en: We can do it, or we can’t do it. Phil, once again our 6 minutes are up, but there’s just a little bit more time for me to tell you more about my podcast, What in the World.
sentences.zh: 我们可以做到这一点,或者我们办不到。 Phil, 再一次,我们的6分钟时间到了,但我还有一点时间告诉你我播客的更多情况,“什么是世界? ”

sentences.en: We have a new episode every single weekday and we talk about the news, trending topics.
sentences.zh: 我们每个周日都有新节目 讨论新闻 热门话题

sentences.en: In fact, it’s a great place to come and learn some new vocabulary about things that are happening in the world.
sentences.zh: 事实上,这是一个伟大的地方 来学习一些关于世界正在发生的事情的新词汇。

sentences.en: Yes, if you’ve found this episode interesting, try watching What in the World on YouTube with subtitles to practise your English.
sentences.zh: 试看YouTube上什么世界, 加上字幕练习英语。

sentences.en: There’s a link in the notes for this episode.
sentences.zh: 笔记里有这集的链接。

sentences.en: And don’t forget to try the quiz and worksheet at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 也不要忘记在bbc学习英语的测验和工作表。

sentences.en: Phil, thank you so much for having me again on 6 Minute English.
sentences.zh: 菲尔,非常感谢你让我再次 6分钟英语。

sentences.en: Bye for now. Bye!
sentences.zh: 再见,再见!
